de.name: Immobilien-Pipeline
de.summary: Zwei Pipelines, die sich beim Kaufvertrag treffen: Objekt hereinholen und vermarkten, Interessenten betreuen, mit Besichtigungen, Fristen und einer Routine für frühere Kunden.
de.description: Ein Maklerbüro arbeitet auf der Eigentümerseite (Bewertung, Maklerauftrag, Vermarktung, Angebote) und auf der Interessentenseite (Anfrage, Qualifizierung, Besichtigungen, Angebot) und danach in einer gemeinsamen Phase nach dem Kaufvertrag mit festen Terminen. Diese Vorlage hält beide Seiten fest, dazu die Art des Maklerauftrags mit Laufzeitende, jede Besichtigung mit Rückmeldung, die Fristen nach Vertragsabschluss und eine terminierte Routine für frühere Kunden. Der Wert eines Objekts steht für die erwartete Provision.

key_date_reminder.title: Makler informieren: Eine Frist läuft in zwei Tagen ab
key_date_reminder.description: Zwei Tage vor einer offenen Frist wird der Zuständige benachrichtigt, damit er den Schritt bestätigt oder nachhakt.

identify_before_contract.title: Identifizierung der Parteien festhalten
identify_before_contract.description: Erreicht ein Objekt die Kaufpreisverhandlung, erinnert eine Aufgabe daran festzuhalten, dass vor dem Vertrag identifiziert wurde.

identify_buyer_offer.title: Identifizierung des Käufers festhalten
identify_buyer_offer.description: Erreicht ein Suchauftrag Angebot abgegeben, erinnert eine Aufgabe daran festzuhalten, dass identifiziert wurde.

buyer_re_engage.title: Interessenten mit neuen passenden Objekten wieder ansprechen
buyer_re_engage.description: Jeden Montag erhält ein Suchauftrag in der Phase Besichtigung ohne Aktivität seit sieben Tagen eine Aufgabe zur Kontaktpflege.

listing_price_review.title: Preis und Vermarktung mit dem Eigentümer prüfen

past_client_monthly_touch.description: Jeden Montag erhält ein früherer Kunde ohne Kontakt seit 30 Tagen eine Aufgabe zur Kontaktpflege.

en.name: Real estate pipeline
en.summary: Two pipelines that meet at the contract: win and market the listing, and work the buyer, with viewings, key dates and a routine for past clients.
en.description: A real estate practice runs an owner side (valuation, listing agreement, marketing, offers) and a buyer side (lead, qualification, viewings, offer), then one shared under-contract phase with hard dates. This template tracks both, the agreement type and its end date, every viewing with its feedback, the key dates after signature and a dated routine for past clients. Value on a listing holds the expected commission.

portal_lead_contact.title: Contact the new lead today
portal_lead_contact.description: A lead that arrives from a property portal or WhatsApp gets a call task due the same day.

prepare_valuation.title: Prepare the valuation and the document checklist
prepare_valuation.description: When a listing moves to Valuation, a valuation task is due the next day.

send_listing_proposal.title: Send the listing proposal
send_listing_proposal.description: After the valuation date, a listing still in Valuation gets a proposal task due the next day.

proposal_message_day_2.title: Follow up on the listing proposal by message
proposal_message_day_2.description: Two days after the proposal is sent.

proposal_call_day_5.title: Call about the listing proposal
proposal_call_day_5.description: Five days after the proposal is sent.

proposal_final_call_day_10.title: Final call about the listing proposal
proposal_final_call_day_10.description: Ten days after the proposal is sent.

prepare_property.title: Prepare the property and publish
prepare_property.description: Photos, plan, energy label and documents; enter the agreement in the register where one is required; then publish. Due three days after the agreement is signed.

agreement_end_review.title: Review the agreement: renew, extend or re-price
agreement_end_review.description: Thirty days before the agreement ends, a listing on the market gets an owner task.

agreement_end_notice.title: Tell the agent that the agreement ends in a week
agreement_end_notice.description: Seven days before the agreement ends, the owner of the listing is notified to decide on renewal.

weekly_owner_update.title: Send the owner update
weekly_owner_update.description: Each week, a listing on the market gets a task to report viewings, feedback and enquiries to the owner.

viewing_feedback.title: Collect the viewing feedback and send it to the owner
viewing_feedback.description: The day after a viewing, a task is created if no feedback is recorded.

offer_notice.title: Tell the agent that an offer needs presenting
offer_notice.description: When a listing reaches the offer stage, the owner of the listing is notified to present the offer today.

listing_key_dates.title: Create the key dates from the contract
listing_key_dates.description: When a listing is under contract, its key dates are created from the contract.

buyer_key_dates.title: Create the key dates from the buyer's contract
buyer_key_dates.description: When a buyer search is under contract, the key dates are created from the contract.

key_date_calendar.title: Add the key date to the agent's calendar
key_date_calendar.description: Every new key date is written to the agent's own calendar.

key_date_reminder.title: Tell the agent that a key date is two days away
key_date_reminder.description: Two days before an open key date, the owner is notified to confirm the step or chase.

completed_handover.title: Hand over and ask for a review
completed_handover.description: Handover checklist, thank-you and review request, due seven days after completion.

completed_anniversary.title: Anniversary call
completed_anniversary.description: One year after completion, a keep-in-touch task is due.

identify_before_contract.title: Record the identification of the parties
identify_before_contract.description: When a listing reaches the offer stage, a task asks you to record that identification was checked before the contract.

identify_buyer_offer.title: Record the identification of the buyer
identify_buyer_offer.description: When a buyer search reaches Offer made, a task asks you to record that identification was checked.

buyer_re_engage.title: Re-engage the buyer with new matching listings
buyer_re_engage.description: Each Monday, a buyer search in the Viewing stage with no activity for seven days gets a keep-in-touch task.

listing_price_review.title: Price and marketing review with the owner
listing_price_review.description: Each Monday, a listing on the market with no viewing for 14 days gets a review task.

past_client_monthly_touch.title: Keep in touch with the past client
past_client_monthly_touch.description: Each Monday, a past client with no contact for 30 days gets a keep-in-touch task.

prompt.intro: Set up a real estate pipeline in my Customermates workspace: listings with the agreement type and end date, buyer searches, viewings with feedback, key dates after the contract is signed, and a dated task for every open record.
questions: Do you work for owners, for buyers or for both? Do you sell, let or both?
In which country do you work, and which agreement types do you use there?
How do enquiries reach you: property portals, your website, WhatsApp or referrals?
Which software holds your listings and publishes them to portals? A reference to it is kept here, nothing is copied.
Which key dates matter in your contracts, for example deposit, financing, inspection or notary?
